title: Homo erectus skull KNM-ER 3733
alt: A 3D scan of the fossil skull KNM-ER 3733, about 1.8 million years old, in the true colours of the bone.

knm-er-3733.title: Homo erectus: cranium (KNM-ER 3733)
knm-er-3733.author: Smithsonian Institution, NMNH Human Origins Program; original: National Museums of Kenya

parts.name: KNM-ER 3733
parts.note: found in 1975 at Koobi Fora, Kenya; about 1.8 million years old. The colours are the scan's own.

parts.name: Brow ridge
parts.note: a thick ridge of bone above the eyes.

parts.name: Low, sloping forehead
parts.note: above the brow ridge, the forehead slopes back.

parts.name: Jutting jaw
parts.note: the upper jaw stands out in front of the face.
